name: Biniarroca
description: A 17th-century Menorcan lloc between Sant Lluís, Es Castell and Maó, a pioneer of the island's rural hotels (opened in 1998 after three years of restoration). Adults only, with two pools among flower-drunk gardens, stone terraces and an à la carte restaurant with a French accent. Romantic without the kitsch.

practicalInfo.acceso: Sant Lluís countryside, between the village, Es Castell and Maó; the airport about 12 minutes away.
practicalInfo.horario: Check the season and dates on the official website.
practicalInfo.servicios: Adults only, two outdoor pools, gardens, à la carte restaurant.

seo.description: Biniarroca, Sant Lluís: a 17th-century lloc and rural-hotel pioneer, adults only, with two pools and gardens.
